context: This work was directly inspired by [1], whose multi-head self-attention we adopt as the backbone of our encoder.
We build on the Transformer of Vaswani et al. (2017) to model long-range dependencies without recurrence.
Pretrained bidirectional encoders such as BERT (Devlin et al., 2019) have since become a standard baseline for transfer learning.
